sources.title: Feng Shui Coaching con Carmen Irizarry
sources.historical_period: 2021-05-02 listed episode; undated current series description
sources.quality_notes: Lines 33–41: named author Carmen Irizarry Fuentes, natal BaZi topics, virtual courses for Puerto Rico, Caribbean and Spanish speakers. Listed 2021 episode concerns basic Feng Shui, not a BaZi lesson. No listening, dated BaZi delivery, credentials or lineage verified.

sources.title: fengshuibycarmen — BaZi service listing
sources.quality_notes: Lines 55, 87–110 and current 225–251: Hatillo Puerto Rico, advertised natal BaZi consultation requiring birth date and exact time; self-reported Master BaZi since 2021. Copy says ocho pilares del destino, not evidence of an eight-pillar rule. Same provider as podcast; no actual client or certification verification.

sources.title: ¿Quién Soy? — Mikura Feng Shui
sources.quality_notes: Lines 7–14 name provider and four pillars, current self-reported Netherlands residence; 124–131 label Dominican Republic client BaZi testimonial, adjacent 2019 workshop refers to Peru, not Dominican Republic. Provider-hosted cross-border reception claim only, no independently verified delivery, residence or date. Duplicate wording in two mentor endorsements at lines 24 and 31 prevents independent testimonial counting.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: Two Carmen listings are one provider cluster; Dominican testimonial is not proof of a local school or dated instruction.
unresolved_lineage_questions: Independent dated BaZi and Ziwei materials, actual course delivery and teacher records in the Caribbean.
